seoBlock.title: Psychological Events and Groups in Europe — Find Your Event
seoBlock.text1: PsyGroup is a catalog of psychological events and programs bringing together offerings from verified professionals across Europe. We help people find safe and quality psychological events: therapeutic groups, workshops and trainings, seminars, lectures, intensives, supervision and intervision groups, conferences, symposia, certification programs, specializations, educational and modular programs.
seoBlock.text2: Every event on the platform goes through moderation. We verify organizers' qualifications, education and experience in psychology or psychotherapy. You see only events where facilitators are certified professionals with confirmed experience.
seoBlock.text3: Meeting formats — online and in-person in cities across Europe. Online events are accessible from anywhere in the world, in-person meetings take place in major cities: Warsaw, Berlin, Prague, Vienna, Amsterdam and others. Hybrid formats combine both options.
seoBlock.text4: Who are our events for? For adults seeking psychological support, wanting to develop self-awareness, work with anxiety, depression, burnout, relationship issues. For professionals — psychologists, psychotherapists, counselors — who want to advance their qualifications, attend supervision, master new methods. For anyone interested in psychology and wanting to learn from leading experts.
seoBlock.text5: Submitting an application takes 2 minutes. Registration is optional — just fill out a short form and the organizer will contact you using the method you provided. Choose an event by topic, format or price and start your journey to change right now.

therapeutic.description: {type} — a safe space where a small group of people (usually 6–12) meets regularly under the guidance of a qualified psychotherapist. Participants explore their experiences together, learn new ways to cope with anxiety, depression, relationship issues, low self-esteem and burnout. Group therapy provides feedback, support and the understanding that you are not alone in your struggles. Suitable for adults, teenagers and couples. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose a therapeutic group by topic and apply on PsyGroup — no registration required.

workshop.description: {type} — practical psychological events where participants develop skills through exercises, interactive techniques and real-life scenarios. Suitable for building self-awareness, communication, emotional intelligence, stress management and professional competencies. Each workshop combines theory and practice led by a certified trainer with years of experience. Duration from a few hours to several days. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose a workshop by topic and apply on PsyGroup — no registration required.

seminar.description: {type} — themed psychological meetings with speakers, presentations and group discussions. Suitable for professional growth, expanding knowledge and exchanging experience with colleagues. Duration from a few hours to several days. Seminars cover current topics from cognitive-behavioral therapy to trauma, crisis and burnout work. Opportunity to ask speakers questions and discuss cases. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose a seminar by topic and register on PsyGroup — no registration on the site required.

lecture.description: {type} — theoretical presentations by experts on current psychology and psychotherapy topics. Suitable for anyone who wants to learn more about how the mind works, modern scientific approaches and research. Speakers are practicing professionals with confirmed qualifications and years of experience. Followed by a Q&A session. Duration 1–3 hours. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose a lecture by topic and apply on PsyGroup — no registration required.

lecture-course.description: {type} — structured educational programs with sequential learning over multiple sessions. Unlike individual lectures, a course provides deeper immersion and a comprehensive understanding of the field. Suitable for professionals who want to master a new method and for anyone interested in psychology. Several sessions of 1.5–3 hours each with homework and discussions. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose a lecture course and register on PsyGroup — no registration required.

intensive.description: {type} — short-term psychological programs with a high concentration of educational material and practice. In just a few days, participants gain deep knowledge and skills that would normally take months. Suitable for those who want to advance quickly in self-understanding or professional growth. Packed schedule with plenty of practice, small group work and feedback from the facilitator. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose an intensive by topic on PsyGroup — no registration required.

author-program.description: {type} — unique methodological approaches developed by leading specialists with years of experience. Each program offers an original perspective on working with a specific issue or field, tested in practice. Transparent pricing, structured format, easy online registration. Suitable for those looking for a non-standard approach to psychological challenges or who want to learn from a specific specialist. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose an author program and apply on PsyGroup — no registration required.

supervision.description: {type} — professional support for practicing psychologists and psychotherapists. During supervision, a specialist discusses their cases with an experienced supervisor, receives feedback, new perspectives and recommendations. It is an essential part of professional practice to maintain quality of work and ethical standards. Individual and group formats available. Suitable for professionals at any level of training. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose a supervisor and register on PsyGroup — no registration on the site required.

intervision.description: {type} — a peer support format among equal professionals without a supervisor. Participants discuss practice cases together, share experience and give feedback. Suitable for psychologists who want to develop reflection and skills in a collegial environment. Democratic format without hierarchy where every participant is both an expert and a learner. Online and in-person across Europe. Find an intervision group on PsyGroup — no registration required.

conference.description: {type} — large-scale psychological events with presentations, panel discussions, workshops and networking. They bring together leading professionals, researchers and practitioners to exchange knowledge and experience. Suitable for anyone who wants to stay current with modern psychology trends and expand their professional network. Duration 1–3 days. Opportunity to ask speakers questions and connect with like-minded professionals. Online and in-person across Europe. Register for a conference on PsyGroup — no registration on the site required.

symposium.description: {type} — academic psychological meetings with presentations and in-depth discussion around a single topic. Unlike conferences, a symposium focuses on a narrow subject and brings in experts for detailed analysis. Suitable for professionals and researchers who want to deepen knowledge in a specific area. The format involves active audience participation in the discussion. Online and in-person across Europe. Register for a symposium on PsyGroup — no registration on the site required.

certification.description: {type} — educational courses with official qualification confirmation upon completion. After successful completion you receive a certificate confirming your competencies in a specific psychology field. Suitable for professionals who want to formalize their skills and enhance their professional status. The program includes theory, practice and final assessment. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose a certification program on PsyGroup — no registration required.

specialization.description: {type} — in-depth educational programs for professionals who want to master a specific psychology direction. Extended training with practice, supervision and final assessment. Suitable for psychologists who want to expand their practice and gain a narrow specialization. Graduates can work with specific issues and client categories. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose a specialization by direction and register on PsyGroup — no registration required.

educational-programs.description: {type} — training courses at every level, from beginners to experienced practitioners. They cover all areas of psychology and psychotherapy. Verified instructors, structured curriculum, practical assignments and feedback. Suitable for those who want to gain new knowledge and skills, change careers or deepen self-understanding. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose an educational program by level and topic on PsyGroup — no registration required.

modular.description: {type} — learning in separate blocks with flexible scheduling. Each module is a self-contained topic that can be studied independently or in sequence with others. Suitable for those who want to combine learning with work and personal life. You choose your own pace and order. Ideal for busy professionals who want to gradually build new competencies. Online and in-person across Europe. Choose a modular program on PsyGroup — no registration required.

pilot.description: {type} — experimental psychological events with new formats and approaches. Be among the first to try innovative methods and help shape new directions in psychology. Often offered at a reduced price. Suitable for those open to new experiences and ready to share feedback. Your experience will help improve the program for future participants. Online and in-person across Europe. Discover something new on PsyGroup — no registration required.

other.description: {type} — all formats of psychological events that don't fit standard categories. Support groups, retreats, themed meetings, experimental formats, art therapy, body-oriented practices and other interesting offerings. Verified organizers, easy online registration. Online and in-person across Europe. Browse offerings and apply on PsyGroup — no registration required.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text1: PsyGroup is a platform that helps people find safe and quality psychological events across Europe. We believe that group work, educational programs and therapeutic events are powerful tools for support and growth, available to everyone.
mission.text2: Our goal is to make the process of finding events simple, transparent, and safe. We connect people with verified organizers and create a community where everyone can find support, learning, or inspiration.

whatIs.title: What are psychological events and groups
whatIs.text1: Psychological events are various formats of work: from therapeutic groups to educational programs. A small group of people (usually 6-12) meets regularly under the guidance of a qualified specialist. Participants share experiences, support each other, and learn new ways to cope with life's challenges.
whatIs.text2: A therapeutic group creates a safe space where you can explore your experiences, receive feedback, and develop interpersonal skills. A support group helps you understand that you are not alone in your struggles.
whatIs.text3: Research shows that group therapy is effective for working with anxiety, depression, relationship issues, low self-esteem, burnout, and many other concerns. Educational programs, workshops, and seminars help develop professional skills and gain new knowledge.

verification.title: How We Verify Organizers
verification.text1: Participant safety is our priority. Each organizer undergoes verification before being listed on the platform:
verification.item1: Confirmation of qualifications and education in psychology or psychotherapy
verification.item2: Verification of professional experience and recommendations
verification.item3: Moderation of event descriptions and programs
verification.text2: We also respond to participant complaints and can remove organizers from the platform if they violate our standards.

forOrganizers.title: For Organizers
forOrganizers.text1: PsyGroup is a convenient tool for psychologists, therapists, and event organizers. We help you find participants and manage events:
forOrganizers.item1: Create and publish events with detailed descriptions
forOrganizers.item3: Manage schedules and communicate with participants
forOrganizers.text2: If you are a psychologist or organizer and want to list your events on the platform, contact us through the contacts page.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Here we've gathered answers to the most common questions about the PsyGroup platform, psychological events and groups.

items.q1: What are psychological events and groups and are they right for me?
items.a1: Psychological events are various formats of work: therapeutic groups, workshops, seminars, lectures, intensives, supervision, educational programs. A therapeutic group is a form of psychotherapy where a small group of people meets regularly under the guidance of a qualified therapist. It's suitable if you're seeking support, want to develop communication skills, or work on personal challenges in a group setting. Educational events are suitable for professional growth and gaining new knowledge.
items.q2: Do I need to register on the site to submit an application?
items.a2: No, registration is not required. You can submit an application to join an event without creating an account. Just fill out a short application form, and the organizer will contact you.
items.q3: What happens after I submit an application?
items.a3: After submitting your application, the organizer receives your contact details and reviews your candidacy. This usually takes 1–3 days. The organizer may approve, decline, or contact you for more details. You'll receive a notification by email.
items.q4: Can I submit applications to multiple events at once?
items.a4: Yes, you can apply to as many events as you like. Each application is reviewed independently by the organizer of the respective event.
items.a5: Each organizer undergoes moderation before being listed on the platform. We verify qualifications, education, and experience in psychology or psychotherapy. Verification usually takes 1–2 business days. We also moderate event descriptions and respond to participant complaints.
items.q6: How much does participation in an event cost?
items.a6: Each organizer sets their own participation cost. Prices vary depending on the format (online or offline), event duration, and facilitator qualifications. You'll see the current cost on each event's page.
items.q7: What if the event isn't right for me?
items.a7: If after the first meeting you realize the event isn't right for you, you can stop participating. We recommend discussing this with the organizer — they may suggest another event or format.
items.q8: Is the information I provide in my application confidential?
items.a8: Yes, all application data is confidential. We only share your application with the organizer of the event you applied to. We don't share data with third parties or use it for marketing. See our Privacy Policy page for details.
items.q9: How can I become an event organizer on the platform?
items.a9: Register on the site, selecting the "Organizer" role. Fill in your qualification and education details — our administrator will verify your profile within 1–2 business days. After verification, you'll be able to publish events.
items.q10: What formats do meetings take place in?
items.a10: Meetings take place in three formats: online (via video conferencing), offline (in-person meetings in cities across Europe), and hybrid (a combination of online and offline formats). Choose the format that's most convenient for you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how PsyGroup ("We", "Us", "the Platform") collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal data when using psygroup.org. We respect your right to privacy and comply with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Ukrainian Law "On Personal Data Protection".

controller.title: Data Controller
controller.text1: The controller of personal data collected and processed through this Platform is PsyGroup.
controller.text2: We determine the purposes and means of processing your personal data and are responsible for its protection in accordance with applicable law.

dataCollection.title: What Data We Collect
dataCollection.intro: We collect only the data necessary for specific purposes. The scope of data depends on how you use the Platform.

applicants.title: If you submit an application
applicants.text1: No registration is required to submit an application for an event. We collect:
applicants.item1: First and last name — to identify you in the application
applicants.item2: Email address — to contact you about your application
applicants.item3: Phone number — if the organizer requires phone contact
applicants.item4: Answers to organizer questions — additional information the organizer requests for participant selection

organizers.title: If you register as an organizer
organizers.text1: Registration is required to create and publish events. We collect:
organizers.item1: Email address and password — to create your account
organizers.item2: First and last name — to display on your organizer profile
organizers.item3: Qualification information — education, certifications, professional organization and status
organizers.item4: Event descriptions — information about groups, workshops, seminars, and other events you publish

technical.title: Technical data
technical.text1: Each time you visit the Platform, we automatically collect:
technical.item1: IP address and device information — for security and fraud prevention
technical.item2: Cookies — to maintain your session, language preferences, and cookie consent
technical.item3: Browser and operating system information — to ensure compatibility

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.text1: We process your personal data only when we have a legal basis:
legalBasis.item1: Consent — you have given consent to the processing (e.g., when submitting an application or registering)
legalBasis.item2: Contract performance — processing is necessary to handle your application or provide services to the organizer
legalBasis.item3: Legitimate interest — ensuring Platform security, preventing fraud, providing technical support
legalBasis.item4: Legal obligation — compliance with applicable legal requirements

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.text1: Your personal data is used exclusively for the following purposes:
dataUsage.item1: Application processing — forwarding your application to the organizer and communicating about participation
dataUsage.item2: Account operation — providing access to organizer features, managing events
dataUsage.item3: Organizer verification — qualification review by an administrator before publishing events
dataUsage.item4: Communication — notifications about application status, events, and Platform changes
dataUsage.item5: Security — protection against unauthorized access, fraud, and abuse

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing with Third Parties
dataSharing.text1: We do not sell your personal data. Data is shared with third parties only in the following cases:
dataSharing.item1: Event organizers — when you submit an application, the organizer receives your contact details for communication
dataSharing.item2: Technical providers — Supabase (database), Resend (email delivery), Vercel (hosting), who process data on our behalf and are required to ensure its protection
dataSharing.item3: Government authorities — only when required by law, based on an official request
dataSharing.text2: All providers who process data on our behalf operate under data processing agreements and ensure an appropriate level of protection.

internationalTransfers.title: International Data Transfers
internationalTransfers.text1: The Platform operates in the EU and Ukraine. Some of our providers may store data outside the European Economic Area (EEA).
internationalTransfers.text2: When transferring data outside the EEA, we ensure an appropriate level of protection through EU Commission Standard Contractual Clauses or adequacy decisions.

cookies.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.text1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. We use cookies to ensure the Platform functions properly.
cookies.text2: We use the following categories of cookies:
cookies.item1: Essential cookies — enable authentication, security, and technical functionality. Do not require consent.
cookies.item2: Functional cookies — store your preferences, such as the selected interface language.
cookies.item3: Consent cookies — record your choices regarding cookie usage.
cookies.text3: We do not use analytics cookies, advertising cookies, or third-party tracking cookies. You can manage cookies through your browser settings or through the cookie consent banner.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention Periods
dataRetention.text1: We retain your data no longer than necessary to achieve the processing purposes:
dataRetention.item1: Application data — retained for the time needed to process the application and communicate with the organizer, then deleted
dataRetention.item2: Organizer account — retained until you request deletion or stop using the Platform
dataRetention.item3: Technical data (logs) — retained for no more than 90 days for security and incident investigation

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.text1: Under the GDPR and the Ukrainian Law "On Personal Data Protection", you have the following rights:
userRights.item1: Right of access — obtain a copy of your personal data that we hold
userRights.item2: Right to rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete data
userRights.item3: Right to erasure — request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
userRights.item4: Right to restriction of processing — request suspension of processing in certain cases
userRights.item5: Right to data portability — receive your data in a structured format for transfer to another controller
userRights.item6: Right to object — object to processing based on legitimate interest
userRights.item7: Right to withdraw consent — withdraw consent to data processing at any time
userRights.text2: To exercise your rights or file a complaint with a supervisory authority (the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights or the relevant data protection authority in your EU country), contact us at the details below.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.text1: The Platform is intended for individuals aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you become aware of any processing of data from a person under 18, please contact us for immediate deletion of such data.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.text1: We may update this Policy. We will notify you of significant changes through a Platform notice or email. We recommend reviewing this page periodically. The last update date is shown at the top of the page.

contacts.title: Privacy Contacts
contacts.text1: If you have questions about the processing of your personal data, exercising your rights, or any other privacy matters, please contact us:

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use ("Terms") govern access to and use of the PsyGroup platform (hereinafter the "Platform"). By using the Platform, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree with any provision, please do not use the Platform.

general.title: General Provisions
general.text1: PsyGroup is an online catalog of psychological events and programs where organizers publish events and visitors discover them and submit applications for participation.
general.text2: The Platform acts solely as a technical intermediary between event organizers and participants. PsyGroup does not provide psychological services directly, does not conduct events, and is not responsible for the content and quality of events organized by third parties.
general.text3: Registration is not required to submit an application for participation. To publish events, organizers register with qualification verification.

access.title: Platform Access
access.text1: By using the Platform, you agree to:
access.item1: Not use the Platform for illegal purposes or in a way that violates the rights of third parties
access.item2: Not attempt to gain unauthorized access to the Platform's systems or other users' data
access.item3: Not copy, distribute, or use Platform content without permission

organizers.title: Organizer Responsibilities
organizers.text1: Organizers who publish events on the Platform agree to:
organizers.item1: Provide accurate information about their qualifications, education, and professional status
organizers.item2: Provide accurate and complete event descriptions, including format, cost, duration, and participation terms
organizers.item3: Hold the necessary qualifications and permits to conduct events in accordance with the laws of the country where the event takes place
organizers.item4: Respond to participant applications promptly and provide complete information about participation terms
organizers.item5: Ensure safe and ethical conduct of events, adhering to professional standards
organizers.item6: Bear sole responsibility for the content and quality of services provided during events

applications.title: Application Submission and Processing
applications.text1: By submitting an application for an event, you:
applications.item1: Provide your personal data to the organizer for application review and communication
applications.item2: Agree to the participation terms set by the organizer
applications.item3: Confirm that the information you provide is accurate
applications.text2: The organizer independently decides to accept or reject applications. PsyGroup does not influence the participant selection process.

moderation.title: Moderation and Verification
moderation.text1: PsyGroup moderates content on the Platform to ensure quality and safety:
moderation.item1: Organizer profiles are reviewed by an administrator before gaining the ability to publish events
moderation.item2: Events are reviewed before publication for compliance with Platform standards
moderation.item3: PsyGroup reserves the right to remove or block content that violates these Terms
moderation.text2: If you believe that content on the Platform violates these Terms or your rights, contact us through the contacts page.
